briefing: Markets were flat and directionless today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.0%), with no risk-on signal strong enough to justify new positions. Cash sits at $389.29, below our $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy — existing 7 positions remain untouched and continue to run on their automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today our cash balance was below the threshold needed for a meaningful new position, and the market gave no strong signal, so the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是預留在場邊、待有力機會出現時才動用的現金。今日現金餘額未達建立新倉位的門檻，加上市況未有明確訊號，因此紀律性的做法是保留現金觀望，而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Today was a quiet, rangebound session with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 essentially flat, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode without a clear catalyst pushing prices in either direction. Low volatility days like this often precede a bigger move once new economic data or earnings news arrives. No major headlines drove today's action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場交投淡靜，納指與標普500指數幾乎持平，反映投資者在缺乏明確催化因素下採取觀望態度。這種低波動的交易日往往是醞釀下一波較大行情的前奏，需待新的經濟數據或財報消息出爐。今日並無重大新聞主導市場走勢。
